accessLocation: Rum River lower corridor, Ramsey and Anoka, Minnesota
decisionScope: DNR's current statewide access-site GIS independently identifies both public access areas and publishes coordinates. DNR Map 3 ties the sites to the Rum River at river miles 9.0 and 1.9, respectively, and the Anoka County page confirms the South County boat and canoe/kayak launches. Keep both published locations as access-area anchors; do not describe either as a surveyed water-entry toe.

postChangeAudits.result: Both endpoints are review; the Germanium endpoint matches authoritative access anchor WAS02989; no source issues.

outcome: All three formerly suspicious endpoint occurrences now match current official public-access site coordinates and audit as review. Their launch locations are supported, but exact water-entry placement remains unverified.
